title: GT7 datalogger compiled track geometry (format v1)
description: Derived vector geometry compiled from a track bundle's border evidence: ordered border polylines, centerline with width and elevation, the road surface as quads, flagged survey gaps, and boundary-length coverage. Recomputed locally whenever the bundle changes; never imported. Stored at data/track-bundles/compiled/<slug>.json.

source.description: Provenance: the evidence this geometry was compiled from.

borders.description: Ordered border polylines per side, split at survey gaps, Douglas-Peucker simplified. Vertices are [x, z, y]; y is null where the metre predates elevation capture.

gaps.description: Unsurveyed spans the ordering bridged, as [x1, z1, x2, z2] segments. Excluded from the drawn borders and counted against coverage.

walls.description: Border cells whose votes settled on 'wall', as short ticks: a line that ran wide into a barrier reads differently from one that ran wide over paint.

centerline.description: Polyline runs of [x, z, y, w]: the road's middle, its elevation (null when neither border knows it) and its measured width. Runs break where either border is unsurveyed.

road.description: The road surface between the border curves as convex quads [x1,z1,x2,z2,x3,z3,x4,z4], adjacent quads sharing edges.

finish.description: The start/finish line as [x1, z1, x2, z2], averaged from recorded lap rollovers.

coverage.description: Coverage measured against the boundary itself, not the driven trail. closed says whether the side's main chain forms a loop - only then is the denominator the whole lap.

road_pct.description: Share of surveyed left-border metres with the right border found across from them - how much of the road surface is resolved.

_bundle_identity.description: Internal staleness key: [mtime_ns, size] of the bundle file this was compiled from.
